article.story: COMMERCE, Texas -- — Jamal West and Michael Gray Jr. both scored 17 to guide Nicholls to an 83-61 victory over East Texas A&M on Monday night. West added eight rebounds and five blocks for the Colonels (9-6, 3-1 Southland Conference). Gray hit five 3-pointers and added six rebounds and three steals. Trae English scored 13 on 5-for-7 shooting. Scooter Williams Jr. and Khaliq Abdul-Mateen scored 12 points apiece to lead the Lions (2-13, 0-4). Williams added four assists and Abdul-Mateen had three steals. Camerin James scored nine. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
